paras: The lynching of Alexander Harris and Sam Bell was the shooting of two Black men by lynchers in Milam County, Texas, on a Sunday night in September 1881, while they were being taken to jail. The two men were accused of murdering W. B. Davidson, a planter they worked for, and the one known report said their bodies were "riddled with bullets."

According to the Dallas Daily Herald, Harris and Bell were accused of "waylaying and murdering" Davidson, a planter in Milam County who employed them. The report gives no details about Davidson's death, how the accusation arose, or how the two men came to be arrested.

On Sunday night, most likely September 18, the two men were "being conveyed to jail" when lynchers stopped them and shot them both to death. The paper does not name the town or the exact place, say who was guarding the prisoners, or give the size of the group that killed them.
No report of an inquest, arrests, or any official response appears in the coverage that was found.

The killing appears in a single paragraph of the Dallas Daily Herald's "Texas Topics" column on September 22, 1881, placed among items about prohibition votes, fires, and railroad news. The item called the victims "two negroes," called the killers "lynchers," and presented the murder accusation without comment and without condemning or defending the killing. No other newspaper report of the killing was found.

The only report found is one brief paragraph in a Dallas paper's state-news column (A1); no local or follow-up report appeared in the searches.

accounts.label: State news column (Dallas Daily Herald)
accounts.gist: Two Black men accused of murdering their employer, a planter, were shot to death by lynchers in Milam County on Sunday night while being taken to jail, and their bodies were riddled with bullets.

framing.detail: No headline; one paragraph in the 'Texas Topics' column that calls the killers 'lynchers' and treats the murder accusation as the reason for the arrest, with no comment.

record_check.dossier: Two people killed in the lynching (Harris and Bell); a total of 3 counts only if Davidson's alleged murder is included, and A1 gives no detail about that killing.
A1 says 'Sunday night'; September 18 is inferred from the Thursday, September 22 issue and is not stated.
